title: From WSIs to Bulk, Spatial and Single-Cell Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of gene expression is key to studying complex diseases like cancer. While Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) and Single-Cell Transcriptomics (scT) provide high-resolution insights, they remain expensive and scarce. In contrast, standard histopathology Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) paired with bulk RNA sequencing are widely available. This work introduces a Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network (GNN) capable of simultaneously predicting bulk, spatial, and single-cell transcriptomics directly from WSIs. By extracting morphological features using a Pathology Foundation Model (PFM) (UNI2-h) and constructing spatial graphs at both patch and cell levels, the model learns the hierarchical relationships within the tissue. The network is trained on a combined dataset of The Cancer Genome Atlas Program (TCGA), Visium, and Xenium samples across lung, kidney, and breast tissues. translated_abstract: 理解基因表达的空间分布是研究癌症等复杂疾病的关键。虽然空间转录组学（ST）和单细胞转录组学提供了高分辨率的洞察，但它们仍然昂贵且数据稀缺。相比之下，标准的组织病理学全切片图像（WSIs）配合bulk RNA测序则广泛可得。这项工作引入了一种多尺度图神经网络（GNN），能够直接从WSIs同时预测bulk、空间和单细胞转录组学。通过使用病理学基础模型（PFM）（UNI2-h）提取形态学特征，并在patch和细胞两个层面构建空间图，该模型学习组织内部的层级关系。该网络在癌症基因组图谱计划（TCGA）、Visium和Xenium样本组成的组合数据集上进行训练，涵盖肺、肾和乳腺组织。研究采用了一种混合训练策略，利……
tldr: 提出一种多尺度图神经网络，能够直接从常规病理全切片图像同时预测bulk、空间和单细胞三个水平的基因表达转录组学，有望大幅降低高分辨率转录组学数据的获取成本。
en_tdlr: A multi-scale graph neural network is proposed that simultaneously predicts bulk, spatial, and single-cell transcriptomics directly from standard histopathology whole-slide images, making high-resolution gene expression profiling more accessible and cost-effective.
